"""Bounded approved-ID selection. Supplier willingness remains a fallible hypothesis."""

import asyncio
import hashlib
import re
from datetime import timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from uuid import UUID, NAMESPACE_URL, uuid5

from pydantic import ValidationError

from ..core import models as m
from ..core.certificates import verify_batch
from ..core.errors import ContractViolation
from ..core.serialization import semantic_hash
from ..intelligence.interpreter import InterpreterConfig, _PRIVATE, ground
from .questions import QUESTION_TEMPLATES
from .testing import MinimumCostTestSelector


class SelectorConfig(InterpreterConfig):
    """Explicit source authorization and provider limits, with no ambient credentials."""


_DIMENSIONS = {
    "lead_time_days": r"\b(delivery|lead time)\b",
    "contract_months": r"\b(commitment|contract|months)\b",
    "payment_days": r"\bpayment\b",
    "volume_per_year": r"\b(volume|units)\b",
    "unit_price": r"\b(price|EUR|€)\b",
}
_COMMERCIAL = re.compile(r"\b(prefer|rather|must|require|cannot|can't|refuse|only|if|unless|provided|subject to)\b", re.I)


def _safe(value):
    """Recursive fail-closed guard; never redact prose while retaining its original identity."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, item in value.items():
            if _PRIVATE.search(key):
                raise ContractViolation("private_disclosure: unauthorized projection field")
            _safe(item)
    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        for item in value:
            _safe(item)
    elif isinstance(value, str) and _PRIVATE.search(value):
        raise ContractViolation("private_disclosure: unauthorized projection text")


def _sources(assessment, state, config):
    thread = next((t for t in state.server.threads if t.supplier_id == assessment.supplier_id), None) if state.server else None
    if thread is None or state.server.session_id != assessment.snapshot.session_id:
        raise ContractViolation("scope_mismatch: selection source thread missing")
    messages = {msg.message_id: msg for msg in thread.conversation.messages}
    if len(messages) != len(thread.conversation.messages):
        raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: duplicate source identity")

    def citation(c):
        msg = messages.get(c.message_id) if isinstance(c, m.MessageSpan) else None
        if (msg is None or msg.speaker != "supplier" or msg.supplier_id != assessment.supplier_id
                or msg.session_id != assessment.snapshot.session_id
                or c.session_id != msg.session_id or c.thread_id != msg.thread_id
                or msg.content_hash not in config.approved_message_hashes
                or msg.content_hash != hashlib.sha256(msg.body.encode()).hexdigest()
                or msg.attachments or msg.observed_sheets or msg.claim_results
                or msg.role is not None or msg.from_name is not None
                or c.end > len(msg.body) or msg.body[c.start:c.end] != c.quote):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: unapproved or forged supporting source")
        _safe(msg.body)
        # Keep conditional antecedents, even when a short quote happens to be exact.
        if re.search(r"\b(if|unless|provided|subject to|conditional)\b", msg.body, re.I) and (
            c.start != 0 or c.end != len(msg.body)
        ):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: conditional scope omitted")
        return c

    return thread, citation


def project_selection(batch, assessment, state, config):
    verify_batch(batch)
    assessment = m.SupplierAssessment.model_validate_json(assessment.model_dump_json())
    if (assessment.snapshot != batch.snapshot or state.run_id != batch.snapshot.run_id
            or state.version != batch.snapshot.state_version or state.config_hash != batch.snapshot.config_hash
            or assessment.supplier_id not in state.case.supplier_ids
            or assessment.assessment_id != "sha256:" + semantic_hash(
                assessment.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"assessment_id"}))):
        raise ContractViolation("stale_state: selection assessment identity mismatch")
    _safe(assessment.model_dump(mode="json"))
    thread, validate = _sources(assessment, state, config)
    refs = []
    for item in (*assessment.observations, *assessment.reported_constraints, *assessment.uncertainties, *assessment.questions):
        refs.extend(validate(c) for c in item.citations)
    for h in assessment.hypotheses:
        if h.numeric_effect is not None:
            raise ContractViolation("private_disclosure: supplier estimate effects are not authorized")
        refs.extend(validate(c) for c in (*h.supporting_refs, *h.contradicting_refs))
    if assessment.status == "ok":
        # The selector does not elevate previously unchecked model interpretations.
        ground(m.AssessmentDraft(**assessment.model_dump(include={
            "observations", "reported_constraints", "hypotheses", "uncertainties", "questions", "unknowns",
        })), m.InterpretInput(kind="interpret", snapshot=batch.snapshot, supplier_id=assessment.supplier_id,
                             conversation=thread.conversation, evidence=()))
    approved = [i for i in batch.items if i.disposition == "approved"]
    if (not approved or len(approved) > 20 or any(i.severity == "error" for i in batch.issues)
            or any(i.candidate.supplier_id != assessment.supplier_id for i in approved)):
        raise ContractViolation("scope_mismatch: unavailable or mixed-recipient selection batch")
    offers = [i for i in approved if i.candidate.contents.kind == "offer"]
    costs = [r.nominal_cost.amount for i in offers for r in i.economic]
    currencies = {r.nominal_cost.currency for i in offers for r in i.economic}
    if len(currencies) > 1:
        raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: relative costs require common currency")
    minimum = min(costs) if costs else None
    history = []
    # Only acknowledged actions with scoped operation proof become past attempts.
    ops = {o.operation_id: o for o in state.operations if o.status == "acknowledged"
           and o.supplier_id == assessment.supplier_id and o.session_id == batch.snapshot.session_id}
    for attempt in state.strategic.attempts:
        if attempt.status == "acknowledged" and attempt.operation_id in ops:
            history.append(f"acknowledged attempt={attempt.attempt_id}; package={attempt.package_fingerprint}")
    history_refs = []
    for refusal in state.strategic.refusals:
        if refusal.supplier_id == assessment.supplier_id and refusal.assessment_id == assessment.assessment_id:
            history_refs.extend(validate(c) for c in refusal.citations)
            history.append(f"reported refusal={refusal.refusal_id}; scope={refusal.scope}; dimension={refusal.dimension}")
    if len(history) > 12:
        raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: scoped history exceeds bound")
    options = []
    for item in approved:
        content = item.candidate.contents
        if content.kind == "offer":
            description = []
            for package, result in zip(content.packages, item.economic, strict=True):
                if not (result.nominal_cost and result.numerically_valid and result.basis_verified and result.must_haves_ok):
                    raise ContractViolation("infeasible: uncertified economics")
                terms = ", ".join(f"{t.field}={t.value}" for t in sorted(package.bindings, key=lambda t: t.field))
                description.append(f"package={package.fingerprint}; {terms}; official buyer cost delta from cheapest="
                                   f"{result.nominal_cost.amount - minimum} {result.nominal_cost.currency}")
            summary = "Offer: " + " | ".join(description)
        elif content.kind == "question" and content.question_id in QUESTION_TEMPLATES:
            summary = f"Question {content.question_id}: {QUESTION_TEMPLATES[content.question_id]}; no monetary ranking"
        else:
            raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: unregistered selection action")
        if history:
            summary += "; relevant scoped history: " + " | ".join(history)
        options.append(m.SelectionOption(candidate_id=item.candidate.candidate_id, evaluation_id=item.evaluation_id,
                                         summary=summary, citations=tuple(dict.fromkeys(history_refs))))
    projection = m.SelectInput(kind="select", snapshot=batch.snapshot, approved_batch_hash=batch.batch_hash,
                               options=tuple(options), assessment=assessment)
    _safe(projection.model_dump(mode="json"))
    if len(projection.model_dump_json()) > config.max_input_chars:
        raise ContractViolation("unsupported_capability: selection input exceeds bound")
    return projection, tuple(dict.fromkeys((*refs, *history_refs)))


def support_selection(selected, baseline, quote, refs):
    citations = tuple(c for c in refs if c.quote == quote) if quote else ()
    if quote and not citations:
        raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: supporting quote is not an approved exact span")
    content = selected.candidate.contents
    if content.kind == "question":
        cue = {"clarify:approval": r"approv|authori|manager|sign.off",
               "clarify:conditions": r"\b(if|unless|provided|subject to|conditional)\b",
               "clarify:terms": r"\b(terms|flexib|unclear|condition)\b"}[content.question_id]
        if not citations or not re.search(cue, quote, re.I):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: clarification lacks material support")
    elif selected.candidate.candidate_id != baseline.candidate_id:
        if not citations or not _COMMERCIAL.search(quote):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: departure lacks a commercial reason")
        # A quotation must address at least one changed permitted dimension. This is
        # a bounded relevance check, not proof of arbitrary entailment or acceptance.
        baseline_item = baseline._selected_item if hasattr(baseline, "_selected_item") else None
        if baseline_item is None:
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: comparison unavailable")
        before = {t.field: t.value for p in baseline_item.candidate.contents.packages for t in p.bindings}
        after = {t.field: t.value for p in content.packages for t in p.bindings}
        changed = {field for field in after if before.get(field) != after[field]}
        if not any(re.search(_DIMENSIONS.get(field, r"(?!)"), quote, re.I) for field in changed):
            raise ContractViolation("ungrounded_output: quotation unrelated to changed terms")
    return citations


class BoundedModelSelector:
    def __init__(self, *, model, clock, config: SelectorConfig):
        self.model, self.clock, self.config = model, clock, config.checked()

    def decision_scope(self, ledger):
        return self.model.decision_scope(ledger)

    async def select_action(self, candidates, assessment, state, budget, research):
        # Compute the certified baseline before any model failure; never change the batch.
        baseline = await MinimumCostTestSelector().select_action(candidates, assessment, state, budget, research)
        call_id = None
        try:
            projection, refs = project_selection(candidates, assessment, state, self.config)
            reserves = float(budget.fallback_reserve_s + budget.submission_reserve_s)
            seconds = min(float(self.config.time_limit_s), float(budget.model_time_limit_s),
                          float(budget.compute_limit_s) - reserves,
                          (budget.deadline_at - self.clock.utcnow()).total_seconds() - reserves)
            if budget.model_call_limit < 1 or seconds <= 0:
                raise ContractViolation("model_timeout: no selection allowance")
            digest = semantic_hash((projection, self.config.model_dump(exclude={"approved_message_hashes"})))
            call_id = UUID(hex=digest[:32])
            request = m.ModelRequest(call_id=call_id, task="select", task_schema_version=self.config.task_schema_version,
                                     prompt_version=self.config.prompt_version, input=projection,
                                     provider_id=self.config.provider_id, protocol_id=self.config.protocol_id,
                                     model_id=self.config.model_id, output_schema_hash=semantic_hash(m.SelectorResponse.model_json_schema()),
                                     correlation_id=call_id)
            mb = m.ModelBudget(deadline_at=self.clock.utcnow() + timedelta(seconds=seconds),
                               time_limit_s=Decimal(str(seconds)), max_tokens=self.config.max_tokens, max_calls=1, retry_limit=0)
            result = await self.model.complete(request, mb)
            if result.call_id != call_id or result.model_id != self.config.model_id:
                raise ContractViolation("model_invalid: selection call/model mismatch")
            if result.kind != "success":
                raise ContractViolation(result.issues[0].code + ": selection unavailable")
            if self.clock.utcnow() >= mb.deadline_at:
                raise ContractViolation("model_timeout: late selection")
            if len(result.raw_response_json) > self.config.max_output_chars:
                raise ContractViolation("model_invalid: oversized selection")
            response = m.SelectorResponse.model_validate_json(result.raw_response_json)
            _safe(response.model_dump(mode="json"))
            selected = next((i for i in candidates.items if i.disposition == "approved"
                             and i.candidate.candidate_id == response.selected_id), None)
            if selected is None:
                raise ContractViolation("invalid_schema: selected ID outside exact approved batch")
            baseline_item = next(i for i in candidates.items if i.candidate.candidate_id == baseline.candidate_id)
            citations = support_selection(selected, baseline, response.supporting_quote, refs, baseline_item)
            decision = m.NegotiationDecision(
                decision_id=uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, candidates.batch_hash + selected.evaluation_id + str(call_id)),
                snapshot=candidates.snapshot, candidate_id=selected.candidate.candidate_id,
                evaluation_id=selected.evaluation_id, approved_batch_hash=candidates.batch_hash,
                selector_id="bounded-model-selector-v1", rationale=f"Approved-ID selection; model_call_id={call_id}; supplier willingness unverified.",
                citations=citations)
            self.model.admit_raw(call_id, result.raw_response_json)
            return decision
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        except (ContractViolation, ValidationError, ValueError, TimeoutError) as error:
            code = str(error).split(":", 1)[0]
            if code not in m.IssueCode.__args__:
                code = "model_invalid"
            return baseline.model_copy(update={
                "selector_id": "bounded-model-selector-v1:fallback", "fallback_code": code,
                "rationale": f"Certified minimum-cost fallback; reason={code}; model_call_id={call_id or 'none'}.",
                "decision_id": uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, candidates.batch_hash + baseline.evaluation_id + code + str(call_id)),
            })
EOF

PER_CALL_TOKENS = 16384

class Clock:
    def utcnow(self):
        return datetime.now(UTC)

    def monotonic(self):
        return time.monotonic()


def services(inputs, clock, transport=None, config=None):
    evaluator = OfficialEconomicEvaluator(oracle=OfficialArithmetic())
    assembler = OfflineContextAssembler(context_builder=LayeredContextBuilder(), projections=EvidenceProjections(),
                                        estimate_builder=SourceCostEstimateBuilder())
    supplier = inputs.target_supplier_id
    interpreter = InputEchoTestInterpreter(supplier_id=supplier)
    selector = MinimumCostTestSelector()
    if transport is not None:
        gateway = AsyncModelGateway(transport=transport)
        hashes = tuple(msg.content_hash for msg in inputs.server.threads[0].conversation.messages)
        ic = InterpreterConfig(provider_id=config.provider_id, protocol_id=config.protocol_id, model_id=config.model_id,
                               prompt_version="grounded-supplier-v1", task_schema_version="assessment-draft-v1",
                               max_tokens=PER_CALL_TOKENS, time_limit_s=Decimal("8"), approved_message_hashes=hashes)

        interpreter = GroundedInterpreter(model=gateway, clock=clock, config=ic)
        selector = BoundedModelSelector(model=gateway, clock=clock, config=sc)
    coordinator = OfflineDecisionCoordinator(

        generator=SuppliedCandidateGenerator(packages=inputs.packages), evaluator=evaluator, selector=selector,

        validator=FinalActionValidator(evaluator=evaluator, clock=clock), payload_encoder=payload_bytes, clock=clock,

class LocalResponses:
    """Explicit fake HTTP envelope rehearsal, never used as a hosted result."""
    def __init__(self, body):
        self.body, self.calls = body, []

    async def __call__(self, wire):
        payload = json.loads(wire.content)
        self.calls.append(payload)
        projection = json.loads(payload["messages"][1]["content"])
        if projection["kind"] == "interpret":
            msg = projection["conversation"]["messages"][0]
            span = dict(session_id=msg["session_id"], thread_id=msg["thread_id"], message_id=msg["message_id"],
                        start=0, end=len(msg["body"]), quote=msg["body"])
            response = dict(observations=[dict(observation_id="observation:local", kind="ambiguity", dimension=None,
                                              summary=msg["body"], citations=[span])], reported_constraints=[],
                            hypotheses=[], uncertainties=[], questions=[], unknowns=[])

            or auth.get("token_accounting") != "utf8-byte-upper-bound-v1"
            or auth.get("dataset_hash") != semantic_hash(dataset)

            or auth.get("max_output_tokens_per_call") != config.max_output_tokens
            or type(auth.get("max_calls")) is not int or auth["max_calls"] < 4
            or type(auth.get("max_total_tokens")) is not int or auth["max_total_tokens"] < 65536):
        raise ValueError("exact provider/model/dataset and absolute call/token authorization required")

    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Always complete local rehearsal before creating any real network-capable transport.

        if authorization is None:

        auth = json.loads(authorization.read_text())
        config = ChatCompletionConfig(base_url=os.environ.get("LLM_BASE_URL", ""),
                                      provider_id=auth.get("provider_id", ""), model_id=os.environ.get("LLM_MODEL", ""),
                                      token_parameter=auth.get("token_parameter", ""),

        model_calls = sum(c.charged_tokens > 0 for c in trace.model_calls)

                         official_costs=[str(r.nominal_cost.amount) for i in trace.evaluations.items for r in i.economic],
                         validation=trace.validation.kind, calls=model_calls,

                         latency_s=[float(c.elapsed_s) for c in trace.model_calls],

                  dataset_hash=semantic_hash(dataset), candidate_universe_hash=universe, calls=calls,

                row.update(input_tokens=result.usage.input_tokens, output_tokens=result.usage.output_tokens)
                if result.usage.input_tokens is not None and result.usage.output_tokens is not None:
                    cost = (result.usage.input_tokens * INPUT_RATE + result.usage.output_tokens * OUTPUT_RATE) / 1000000
                    row["uncached_usage_cost_usd"] = str(cost)

                    self.reserved += max(Decimal(0), cost - CALL_USD)

                "uncached_reported_usage_cost_usd": str(sum(

class HistoricalClock:
    """Synthetic offline evidence clock, real elapsed inference time; no remote authority."""

    def utcnow(self):
        return AS_OF + timedelta(seconds=time.monotonic() - self.start)

    def monotonic(self):

def record(trace, example_id, arm):
    trace.verify()
    if trace.validation is None or trace.validation.kind != "valid":
        raise ValueError("independent final validation failed")
    selected = next(i for i in trace.evaluations.items if i.candidate.candidate_id == trace.decision.candidate_id)
    action = selected.candidate.contents
    if action.kind == "question":
        label = action.question_id
    else:
        bindings = {t.field: t.value for t in action.packages[0].bindings}
        label = "delivery" if bindings["lead_time_days"] == 49 else (
            "commitment" if bindings["contract_months"] == 12 else "minimum")
    return dict(example_id=example_id, arm=arm, action=label, admitted=True,
        selected_candidate_id=trace.decision.candidate_id,
        official_costs=[str(r.nominal_cost.amount) for r in selected.economic],
        all_official_costs=[str(r.nominal_cost.amount) for i in trace.evaluations.items for r in i.economic],
        assessment_status=trace.assessment.status,
        fallback=trace.decision.fallback_code is not None, fallback_code=trace.decision.fallback_code,
        grounded_departure=label != "minimum" and bool(trace.decision.citations) and trace.decision.fallback_code is None,
        calls=len(trace.model_calls), charged_tokens=sum(c.charged_tokens for c in trace.model_calls),
        unknown_usage_calls=sum(c.usage.input_tokens is None or c.usage.output_tokens is None for c in trace.model_calls),
        latency_s=sum(float(c.elapsed_s) for c in trace.model_calls),
        model_outputs=[dict(task=c.request.task, transport_status=c.result_kind,
                           issues=[i.detail for i in c.issues]) for c in trace.model_calls],

async def connectivity(preflight, config, guard, output):
    trace = OfflineDecisionTrace.model_validate_json((preflight / "message-0-model.json").read_text())
    original = trace.model_calls[-1].request
    option = next(o for o in original.input.options if o.candidate_id == trace.decision.candidate_id)
